evals.prompt: 마크다운 리뷰 보고서만 만들어줘. HEAD~3..HEAD 범위야.
evals.expected_output: Runs the shared code-review analysis over the requested range and stops after writing the Markdown artifact under `.reviews/`, with no HTML file and no browser open.
assertions: The Markdown report is written under `.reviews/` with the shared naming rule.
No HTML report is generated and no browser is opened.
The shared evidence-first writing contract from `code-review` is applied unchanged.

evals.prompt: Save a markdown review of the working tree. I want to paste it into a PR comment.
evals.expected_output: Produces the Markdown artifact and a fact-only handoff carrying severity counts, overall risk, the artifact path, and the verification performed.
assertions: The handoff reports severity counts and the artifact path instead of repeating the report prose.
No fixed finding count is promised before the analysis completes.
The report body is suitable to paste without an HTML dependency.

evals.prompt: Review the last commit and open the styled HTML report for me.
evals.expected_output: Reports that HTML output belongs to the default workflow and routes the request to code-review.
assertions: No HTML report is produced by this skill.
The request is routed to `code-review` by name.
The Markdown-only boundary is stated rather than quietly extended.

evals.prompt: Markdown review only. Go ahead and put `.reviews/` into .gitignore for me since you are already writing there.
evals.expected_output: Suggests the ignore line in the handoff and leaves `.gitignore` untouched.
assertions: The suggestion appears only because an artifact was generated and `.reviews/` is not already ignored.
The refusal names the same rule the main review workflow applies.
